title: extractBlock
body:
## extractBlock

Extracts selected blocks from a composite dataset (multiblock, partitioned dataset collection or AMR), such as the internalMesh or individual patches of an OpenFOAM case read by foam. Blocks are chosen by selectors, path expressions over the input's block hierarchy such as "/Root/internalMesh" or "//inlet". The output keeps the composite type with only the selected blocks (overlapping AMR becomes a partitioned dataset collection). Use merge afterwards when one dataset is needed; pvExtractBlock also exposes the assembly choice.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Selectors that match nothing give an empty composite rather than an error; check names in the input hierarchy (Studio lists them).
- Only blocks that the reader loaded can be extracted; enable the patches in the reader options first.

Native constructor: `ExtractBlock`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Specify the input to this filter. Accepted data: multiblock datasets (vtkMultiBlockDataSet); AMR data (vtkUniformGridAMR); partitioned dataset collections (vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkMultiBlockDataSet","vtkUniformGridAMR","vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectors` | Choose named parts of the input dataset, such as internalMesh or individual wall patches. Studio reads the input hierarchy and writes the native selector paths for you. Only blocks loaded by the reader can be selected. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "extractBlock",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  },
  "options": {
    "selectors": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
